_comment: Pronunciation dictionary the TTS learns from. Key = how it's shown; value = how it's SPOKEN. audit_script.py wraps spoken terms as {key|value} (slides show the key, the voice says the value) and re-syncs existing wraps when this file changes. F5 cannot spell letters (it turns 'A W S' into 'AwubuS'), so: use the FULL NAME for anything that has one, and DOTTED form (e.g. 'S.A.A.-C. zero three') only for codes with no expansion. Add a term here once and every build fixes it everywhere. Omit acronyms already said correctly as a word (RAM, JSON, YAML, ARN, NAT, CIDR, SaaS, REST).
